segments.mil7.6.6:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘satapattassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabban”ti?
segments.mil7.6.6:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, satapatto ravitvā paresaṃ khemaṃ vā bhayaṃ vā ācikkhati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena paresaṃ dhammaṃ desayamānena vinipātaṃ bhayato dassayitabbaṃ, nibbānaṃ khemato dassayitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.6.6:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, satapattassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
